scope.constraints: homogeneous fixed supports already resolved by PreparedDynamicSystem
scope.method: lowest-frequency real symmetric generalized eigenpairs only

preregistered_numerical_policy.positive_definite_diagonal_scaling: D^-1/2 A D^-1/2 where D=diag(A); every diagonal entry must be positive
preregistered_numerical_policy.sparse_positive_definiteness_method: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh(k=1, which='SA') on diagonally scaled symmetric input; convergence and Ritz residual are mandatory; report as a numerical SPD screen, not a formal proof
preregistered_numerical_policy.cluster_cut_policy: REJECT_EXPLICITLY; never increase requested mode count silently

modal_basis.normalization: Phi.T M Phi is explicitly computed; each mode is mass-normalized and the full Gram matrix is checked
modal_basis.complex_rhs: real Phi projection preserves both real and imaginary components
modal_basis.selection: lowest positive modes from the selected existing dense/eigsh/lobpcg backend; sparse backend is not used to request a full large spectrum
modal_basis.equivalence: separate mass-metric subspace comparison invariant to mode sign, ordering and admissible rotations; exact basis identity remains byte/content specific
modal_basis.participation: computed only for explicitly supplied reduced-coordinate influence vectors; cumulative ratio is not a local-error guarantee
modal_basis.truncation: records selected low-frequency range and unrepresented spectrum; no residual-flexibility correction

rayleigh_physical_projected.reaction_availability: NOT_COMPUTED until a consumer performs full-space equilibrium recovery

prescribed_modal.formula: Cr[j,j]=2*zeta_j*omega_j for isolated modes and non-cluster singletons
prescribed_modal.validation: zeta finite and non-negative; frequency strictly positive; zero zeta is valid
prescribed_modal.cluster_policy: all zeta values within an identified cluster must agree within the preregistered tolerance; a cluster receives the invariant scalar block 2*mean(zeta_j*omega_j)*I, recorded as an invariant cluster operator
prescribed_modal.reaction_availability: UNAVAILABLE; no complete physical C is inferred or fabricated
prescribed_modal.direct_equivalence: not presumed; only under exact operator, damping, basis, excitation, initial-state and scheme compatibility

result_availability.projected_excitation: AVAILABLE when a compatible WP03 bound channel set is supplied
result_availability.physical_reactions: NOT_COMPUTED for Rayleigh basis preparation; UNAVAILABLE for prescribed modal damping without full-space C
result_availability.full_response: NOT_APPLICABLE in WP04; no forced-response or transient solver is implemented

tests_required: coupled non-diagonal mass and independent projection identity
mass normalization, orthogonality, residuals and projected M/K
WP03 real and complex excitation projection without reassembly
full-basis projection identity on bounded fixtures
Rayleigh projected damping and prescribed modal damping
unequal damping within a cluster rejected
singular mass, non-positive stiffness and rigid modes rejected
operator mutation invalidates basis while excitation mutation does not
all five WP00 element families, sparse storage and historical ModalAnalysisSolver non-regression
